entities.name: Otawara
entities.description: A Soratami city resting on clouds in the sky of Kamigawa, floating above Lake Kamitaki.

entities.name: Soratami
entities.description: The moonfolk who built and live in Otawara.

entities.name: Oboro
entities.description: The cloud palace of the Soratami in Otawara, sacred ground where non-moonfolk are still forbidden.

entities.name: Toshiro Umezawa
entities.description: A man who secretly followed the soratami prophet Chiyo to Otawara during the Kami War.

entities.name: Chiyo
entities.description: A soratami prophet who attacked Toshiro in Otawara.

entities.name: Hidetsugu
entities.description: Owner of an oni hound that Toshiro summoned to Otawara.

entities.name: Shadow Gate
entities.description: A gate Toshiro used to escape from Otawara.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: The war during which Toshiro followed Chiyo to Otawara.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: An invasion during which Otawara was badly damaged.

events.summary: During the Kami War, Toshiro Umezawa secretly follows Chiyo to Otawara and reveals himself; she attacks him in rage.
events.quote: Toshiro Umezawa secretly followed the soratami prophet Chiyo to the streets of Otawara

events.summary: Toshiro cracks Chiyo's nose, summons Hidetsugu's oni hound to Otawara, and escapes through the Shadow Gate.
Otawara is badly damaged in the New Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: The city was badly damaged during the New Phyrexian Invasion

relations.quote: Otawara is a Soratami city resting on clouds

relations.note: She attacked him, incensed at his presence.
